senses.gloss: m. (v. Syr. נדנדא, דנדלא, P. Sm. 2290, 925) polyp, centipede. Sifra Sh’mini, Par. 10, ch. XII, expl. מרבה רגלים (Lev. XI, 42); Ḥull. 67ᵇ.—
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 5:3">Mikv. V, 3</cite> <he>מעין שהוא משוך כנ׳</he> a well the waters of which are conducted in channels radiating like the feet of a centipede.
